reviewer: Codex preparation audit; final instructor review and classroom timing remain pending
scope: Every close/context pair was visually inspected. This is a teaching-usability check, not a new morphology classification or remeasurement of a source center. Catalog identities/provenance were compared with existing audited local reference records. The reviewer was not blind to reference labels; no independent human blind-classification accuracy is claimed.
grading_policy: Use secure catalog reference classes as external evidence, not a guarantee that the supplied Gaia/JPEG data uniquely determine class. Assess evidence notes, uncertainty, confidence, and citations manually. A justified uncertain answer may receive full reasoning credit. No automatic final grade or numerical pass threshold is assigned; Task 3 has no supplied solution.
epoch_note: Gaia DR3 coordinates have reference epoch J2016.0; Legacy Survey images combine exposures at other dates. Visible centering was checked qualitatively. A uniform proper-motion propagation to one image epoch was not performed.
